entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to the network in response to a tracking area update accept message if a GUTI has been changed or a new TMSI has been assigned.

entities.name: Protocol discriminator
entities.description: Identifies the protocol type for the message.

entities.name: Security header type
entities.description: Specifies the security header format for the message.

entities.name: Tracking area update complete message identity
entities.description: Identifies the message type as TRACKING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE.

entities.name: GUTI changed condition
entities.description: Condition where the GUTI has been changed during tracking area update procedure.

entities.name: New TMSI assigned condition
entities.description: Condition where a new TMSI has been assigned during tracking area update procedure.

entities.name: Tracking area update procedure
entities.description: Procedure for updating UE tracking area information with the network.

relations.description: TRACKING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE message is sent as part of the tracking area update procedure.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE message contains the protocol discriminator information element.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE message contains the security header type information element.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE message contains the message identity information element.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE message is sent when GUTI has been changed.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE message is sent when a new TMSI has been assigned.
